macro-expansion diagnostic column and excerpt are C44-DIAG-COLUMN-01 (0.0.44): line is right, column and excerpt follow the expanded text; owner delegated the scope to cc 2026-10-31

column1: # 2026-10-31 (R4): the stand-alone single-stream container is a non-product build artifact; the installed product cannot take it (grk's study: route names are rewritten to "stream", the product compiles C and rejects bare UNITOK1/USLATTR1, executor budget is a constant, tools/stream-runtime.c needs the archived exec/c/run.c).

column3: single-stream containers (non-product build) are C44-STREAM-CONTAINER-01 (0.0.44): rebuild the stream runtime from the current tree; 0.0.43 ships the five-slice unisacc.com whose per-stream behaviour is covered through the product routes; owner delegated the scope to cc 2026-10-31

column1: # 2026-10-31 (R5): user malloc under RLIMIT_AS: include/stdlib.h _unisa_map treats only -1 and 0 as failure, raw syscall 9 returns -ENOMEM (-12); the header ships inside the package, so the fix is a new candidate and changes every user image that links the allocator.

column3: user-program malloc returning -ENOMEM as an address under RLIMIT_AS is C44-MALLOC-01 (0.0.44): fix include/stdlib.h _unisa_map (ret<0 is failure) and regenerate include/cx-flat.h via tools/cx-flatten.cx; needs a new package and changes the bytes of user images that use the allocator; owner delegated the scope to cc 2026-10-31
